# pip-audit allowlist for Wasden Watch
#
# Purpose: explicitly ignore specific CVE / advisory IDs that have been
# triaged and accepted as "no safe upgrade path right now". This file is
# consumed by the `security` job in .github/workflows/ci.yml.
#
# Format (one entry per non-blank, non-comment line):
#     <VULN_ID>     # YYYY-MM-DD  rationale (revisit by YYYY-MM-DD)
#
# Examples:
#     GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx   # 2026-05-11  pinned old mlflow; bump blocked by
#                           #             breaking change in tracking API.
#                           #             Revisit by 2026-06-30.
#     PYSEC-2024-12345      # 2026-05-11  transitive dep, no fix available.
#                           #             Revisit when upstream releases fix.
#
# Rules:
#   1. Every entry MUST have a dated rationale and a revisit-by date.
#   2. Prefer bumping the version over allowlisting whenever the upgrade
#      path is safe. Allowlist is the escape hatch, not the default.
#   3. Re-review every entry at least quarterly.
#
# When this file is empty (only comments), pip-audit runs WITHOUT any
# --ignore-vuln flags (strict mode against the full OSV database).
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2026-05-11 triage of PR #36 pip-audit findings
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 47 of 63 CVEs resolved by direct + transitive bumps in backend/requirements.txt.
# 16 residual CVEs allowlisted below — three categories:
#
#   A. mlflow tracking-server CVEs. We use mlflow ONLY as a Python tracking
#      client (src/intelligence/quant_models/mlflow_tracking.py) and never run
#      `mlflow server` / `mlflow ui` in production. These CVEs require an
#      attacker to reach the MLflow web app; not in our threat model.
#      Fix path is mlflow 3.x (major bump) or unreleased / RC versions.
#      Per triage guidance, holding at 2.22.4 (latest 2.x).
#
#   B. starlette CVE-2025-62727. Fix is starlette 0.49.1 but fastapi 0.119.1
#      pins starlette<0.49.0. Bumping fastapi to >=0.124.0 unblocks this.
#      Holding for a separate, scoped fastapi-bump PR.
#
#   C. transformers CVE-2026-1839. Affects the `Trainer` class, which we do
#      not import (we use sentence-transformers for embeddings only — no
#      training). Fix is 5.0.0rc3, an RC, which violates the "no RCs in prod"
#      rule. Revisit when transformers 5.0.0 ships GA.
#
# All entries below revisit by 2026-06-10 (30 days from triage date).
